input.text: Dormant accounts are charged a maintenance fee of $5 per month.
sources: Dormant accounts are charged a maintenance fee of $5 per month.

input.text: An account with no activity initiated by the customer for 12 months is classified as dormant.
sources: An account with no customer-initiated activity for 12 months is classified as dormant.

input.text: Customers receive written notice 30 days before their account becomes dormant.
sources: Customers receive written notice 30 days before their account becomes dormant.

input.text: Customers may request a fee refund within 60 days of the statement date.
sources: Customers may request a fee refund within 60 days of the statement date.

input.text: Personal bankers may waive service fees up to $25 per account in a calendar year. With branch manager approval noted in the account, they may waive up to $50 per account in a calendar year.
sources: Personal bankers may waive service fees up to $25 per account in a calendar year, or up to $50 with branch manager approval noted in the account.
